disagreements_with_first_check: Agree with the twelve first-check corrections in their stated scope. Additional clarification: a post-relaxation write changes lock mismatch, not fixed-region PD-34 charge; Q34's distinction must carry into this seat.
No independent certification of the large kinetic simulation tables is claimed.
corrections: Separate physical field charge, PD-34 background-relative charge and energy-lock mismatch.
Keep the positive result: relaxation can make unwritten newborns look blank to gamma. It does not demonstrate the required geometry or long-range attraction.
Cold flips, Delta=0 transport surrogate and instant carrier walks remain modelling assumptions.
plain_summary: The flip energetics and two-end bookkeeping are correct. Relaxation transfers a mismatch; it does not simply delete charge. The trap energy lies about 100,000 crossing amplitudes below the blank-pair level, supporting the reported trapping mechanism in its reduced model. The written-share formula also reproduces the key rate dependence. A write after relaxation creates a lock mismatch, not necessarily new PD-34 charge. Irreversible relaxation needs the stated dynamics beyond a downhill Hamiltonian matrix element. Gravity remains open; the large growth simulations were not independently repeated here.
